summary: HCW Biologics filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, disclosing an Exclusive Distribution Agreement signed September 4, 2026, with Akron Biotech for its HCW11-006 molecule as a cell-therapy manufacturing reagent, excluding China, for five years. HCW receives $200,000 at closing, $100,000 within 30 days of a Supply Agreement and $100,000 on each of the first two anniversaries, plus quarterly technical-support payments. Closing is due by November 30, 2026, subject to due diligence and testing. This is a commercial distribution contract, not a special situation.
